map.：静息能量 RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal；每日: : resting energy RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal; daily requirement DER = 393.6 × 1.6 (normal, not neutered) = 629.8 kcal. Total treat calories = 15 × 5 = 75 kcal, 11.9% of the daily total, exceeding the 10% safe limit (≈63 kcal). Reduce to at most 4 treats a day, or switch to 2–5 kcal training treats. For comparison, a 4 kg cat with the same 5 kcal/treat × 3 is only 6.94%, still within the safe range.
map.为什么狗狗和猫咪的算法不一样？: Why do dogs and cats use different algorithms?
map.犬用 Kleiber 幂律 RER=70×体重^0.75（更适合跨体型缩放），猫: Dogs use the Kleiber power law RER=70×weight^0.75 (better for scaling across body sizes), while cats use the linear RER=40×weight+20 (an empirical form for small felids); both then multiply DER by activity/neuter/age factors. Mixing the formulas systematically over- or under-estimates calories.
map.零食超标了一定要减颗数吗？: If treats exceed the limit, must I cut the count?
map.优先减颗数或换低热量零食；若已超标较多（>20%），还应相应扣减主粮份量（本例需: First reduce the count or switch to lower-calorie treats; if the excess is large (>20%), also reduce the main food accordingly (in this example about 12 kcal off the main food). The general veterinary principle is that treats stay under 10% of total daily calories.
